children.name: Quillaja brasiliensis  Mart.
children.description: Quillaja brasiliensis is a plant of the genus Quillaja native to Brazil.

children.name: Quillaja saponaria Molina
children.description: Quillaja saponaria, the soap bark tree or soapbark, is an evergreen tree in the family Quillajaceae, native to warm temperate central Chile.

children.name: Quillaja smegmadermis St.Laz.
children.description: Treated by Plants of the World Online as a synonym of Quillaja saponaria, the Chilean soapbark tree (quillay), the only extant genus of family Quillajaceae (order Fabales). Q. saponaria is an evergreen tree to about 25 m endemic to the sclerophyll forests of central Chile; its saponin-rich inner bark yields a natural soap and is a commercial source of saponins used as adjuvants and foaming agents.
